messages:
Mel: quick heads-up — I'm kicking off a base image rebuild for runtime nodes tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need to confirm RBAC for the new signer role and audit-log ingestion path.
Priya: thanks — can you list the exact permissions you expect the signer to have? Cosign upload only, or access to GCR/GCS objects too?
Mel: ideal: cosign sign/push to staging registry + read-only list on prod buckets for attestation fetch. No write to prod buckets.
Ben: for KMS, do we plan to use the existing KMS key (projects/rw-infer/keys/cosign) or a dedicated rotation key per environment?
Mel: prefer dedicated per-env if ops can manage rotation windows. Otherwise fallback to shared with strict IAM.
Alex: @Mel, if we create a signer principal, security wants it as short-lived token only — no long-lived service account key. Use Workload Identity / OIDC where possible.
Priya: +1. Also we should emit explicit audit logs for "cosign.sign" and "container.push" events to the security audit project. How will those logs be forwarded?
Mel: plan: router -> audit-forwarder -> security-audit project via Cloud Audit Logs export. For on-prem, syslog shipper to ELK.
Ben: do we have an existing log schema? We need fields: actor, action, image_digest, signer_key_id, build_id, trace_id.
Mel: yep — use the schema in /infra/audit-schemas/image-attest-v1.json (I'll paste snippet):
```
{"actor":"string","action":"string","image_digest":"string","signer_key_id":"string","build_id":"string","trace_id":"string","timestamp":"rfc3339"}
```
Alex: perfect. One more: RBAC mapping. Proposal: role 'image/signer' grants iam.serviceAccounts.actAs on signer SA + cloudkms.cryptoSign on key version. Reviewer: @Priya @Ben
Priya: minor nit: actAs should be scoped to the runner SA only (image-build-runner@). Not wildcard.
Ben: also ensure signer can't list other keys. Limit to key ring path.
Mel: noted. On vuln triage: we found glibc CVE in base at low->medium frequency. I'm trimming packages down and rebuilding with musl where possible. Any blockers?
Alex: musl <-> some internal deps may break. Please run canary with 10% fleet and highlight any segfaults.
Priya: add a feature flag to rollout so SRE can cut traffic. We need observability for process crashes.
Mel: will add feature flag + probe that posts to #eng-oncall on crash.
security-bot: INCIDENT BOT: New rebuild job queued (job_id=rbld-2026-0422-01). ETA 09:00 PT.
Ben: for incident response, if the canary fails we should auto-rollback to signed fallback image and notify PagerDuty. Who owns PD on this? @Alex?
Alex: I'll be primary oncall. Configure fallback image tag = signed-fallback:v2026-04-21.
Priya: one more compliance ask: retention of attestation logs must be 3 years for regulated customers. Make sure audit export lifecycle set accordingly.
Mel: will set export TTL to 1095 days and add a policy for customer-scoped logs.
Ben: KMS rotation question — if key rotates, how do we validate old attestations? We need to keep public keys around for verification.
Mel: store rotated public keys in keyserver S3 path s3://rw-keys/attest-pub/ with versioning + signed metadata manifest. Verifier will consult manifest.
Priya: test plan?
Mel: steps I'm putting in the runbook:
1) create signer SA with scoped iam: actAs on runner SA only
2) grant cloudkms.cryptoSign on key ring/cosign/{env} to signer SA
3) wire audit export to security-audit with schema mapping
4) dry-run: sign image in staging, run 10% canary on staging cluster
5) monitor crashes + audit events for 48h
6) on success, promote to 50% then 100% with 1h holds

I'll post the runbook link after I upload. Anyone wants preflight SSH to help debug builder image?
Alex: I can join 08:30 PT for preflight.
Priya: I'll review RBAC JSON and audit export config.
Ben: I'll validate KMS IAM and keyserver permissions.
Mel: thanks all. tagging ticket RW-2468. Will update thread after preflight. :thumbsup:
